purpose: Compile the current JANUS/OSIRIS project corpus into a modern algorithmic control model and compare it against the current exact-plus-advisory TRUMP architecture without claiming that ancient Egyptian texts were literally algorithms and without promoting symbolic correspondences into theorem evidence.

osiris_algorithm.name: OSIRIS_RETURN_SPIRAL_PROOF_CARRYING_SEARCH

state.canonical_coordinate: immutable canonical representation of the current problem/subproblem
state.experience_layers: append-only verified route/provenance/receipt layers attached to the canonical coordinate
state.missing_members: unresolved components, boundaries or proof obligations
state.origin_generation: monotone generation number advanced only after finalized return

phases.operation: Canonicalize input, freeze source identity, budgets, proof authority and memory epoch.
phases.invariant: No later learning may rewrite this origin or its negative/open receipts.

phases.operation: Compute structural fingerprint; identify known exact substructures and distinguish identity from similarity.
phases.invariant: Recognition proposes routes but does not establish truth.

phases.operation: Represent every unresolved proof obligation explicitly as a missing member/boundary rather than converting OPEN or absence into failure.
Generate exact decomposition routes plus advisory alternatives from frozen prior receipts; high predicted-regret alternates remain shadow-only unless a preregistered gate authorizes exact execution.
phases.invariant: Advisory memory may order work but may not alter formula semantics or proof authority.

phases.operation: Independently recompute children/components, preserve fingerprints, source identity, route provenance and resource accounting.
phases.invariant: Every promoted component must carry a replayable witness/receipt.

phases.operation: Hash-cons canonically identical exact subproblems; combine verified component results with an exact reassembly operator while retaining multiple experience histories separately.
phases.invariant: Proof-node sharing may merge identical exact states; history/provenance must not be erased by that merge.

phases.operation: Replay the assembled result backward to the frozen origin and verify the complete route from leaves/components to root.
phases.invariant: RETURN confirms origin only after exact replay.

phases.operation: Promote terminal truth only if exact replay closes; otherwise preserve OPEN with its unresolved member set and resource receipt.

After finalization only, append the verified experience layer and mint the next memory generation. The same canonical coordinate may now carry more verified history without changing its exact mathematical identity.
Expose the finalized prior generation to future problems as frozen advisory memory; never let the current holdout train its own router.

pseudocode: K_exp = HASH(K_exact || receipt.parent || receipt.route || M_prev.epoch || receipt.verification_digest)

osiris_to_trump_crosswalk.trump: canonical root CNF + pinned C025/R5 source identity + frozen benchmark/memory epoch
R5 exact OR-lift/restriction DAG plus R6 receipt-grounded advisory routing
independent exact child verification and full R5/C025 replay back to the original root
finalized exact receipts become later M2R advisory memory while the original exact result remains immutable
explicit OPEN residual, unresolved child, cap/depth/node-budget obstruction or missing proof obligation
R5 residual DAG, exact child combination and hash-consed repeated-subtree reuse
structural fingerprinting, family recognition and source-identity lock
sealed receipts, fingerprints, independent replay, adversarial gates and immutable negatives
post-finalization persistent memory generation used only by later problems
SAT/UNSAT terminal authority only after exact replay; advisory route choice has no proof authority
truth clock and resource/work clock are separate; cost prediction may not become correctness evidence

osiris_to_trump_crosswalk.osiris: Spear as path/vector rather than physical object
osiris_to_trump_crosswalk.trump: route/pivot/decomposition proposal is a direction through search space, not a proof object
R6 shadow/counterfactual lanes can point to a route but have zero proof-selection/effect authority
frozen holdouts, benchmark relevance checks, adversarial controls and requirement that exposure exists before interpreting a negative
challenger/diversity routes remain bounded by regret guard and exact replay

osiris_to_trump_crosswalk.osiris: same coordinate does not imply same state
osiris_to_trump_crosswalk.trump: exact formula identity and accumulated receipt/history state are currently conceptually separate but not yet formalized as a dual-key primitive

mechanism.K_exact: hash of canonical exact formula/subproblem; sole key for exact memo/hash-cons/proof reuse
mechanism.K_experience: hash of K_exact plus finalized route receipt, parent receipt, memory epoch and verification digest; advisory only
mechanism.attachment: many K_experience layers may attach to one K_exact without duplicating exact proof nodes

new_candidate_mechanisms_extracted_from_.why: Implements SAME_COORDINATE_NE_SAME_STATE without destroying R5 hash-cons sharing.
new_candidate_mechanisms_extracted_from_.expected_testable_effect: better receipt-grounded cost prediction and provenance retention when the same exact residual is reached through different routes/generations

new_candidate_mechanisms_extracted_from_.mechanism: When an exact node returns OPEN, serialize the obstruction type and minimal boundary signature: cap overflow, unresolved child set, depth exhaustion, node-budget exhaustion, cross-product pressure, separator/cycle boundary. Use only this structural signature to propose the next exact decomposition family.
new_candidate_mechanisms_extracted_from_.why: Turns 'what is missing from the body' into a solver-local decomposition signal instead of treating OPEN as a scalar failure.

new_candidate_mechanisms_extracted_from_.mechanism: Whenever the same K_exact reappears, compare new versus prior verified experience layers for exact paid work, route family, child-call count, cache hits and unresolved boundaries; feed only finalized deltas into later advisory memory.
new_candidate_mechanisms_extracted_from_.why: Operationalizes ORIGIN -> EXPERIENCE -> RETURN -> ORIGIN_PRIME as measurable state enrichment.

new_candidate_mechanisms_extracted_from_.mechanism: Every route receipt carries separate truth_clock and resource_clock fields; no arithmetic or threshold may combine them into one scalar authority score.
new_candidate_mechanisms_extracted_from_.why: Makes the existing TRUMP correctness-vs-cost firewall machine-checkable at every layer.

integration_recommendation.recommended_first_use: Instrument R6_3 in shadow mode with O_DELTA_1 dual-key history and O_DELTA_2 missing-member signatures while leaving route selection, regret threshold and exact authority unchanged.
promotion_gate: measure online full work including feature/provenance overhead
demonstrate a causal improvement over unchanged current R6 or preserve as telemetry-only

deep_comparison_verdict.strongest_new_transfer: Formal dual-key separation of exact canonical identity from accumulated experience/provenance state, allowing same exact node reuse while preserving ORIGIN_PRIME history layers.
deep_comparison_verdict.secondary_new_transfer: Treat OPEN as an explicit missing-member boundary signature that can guide future exact decomposition families without becoming evidence of falsity.
deep_comparison_verdict.scientific_ceiling: These are algorithm-design candidates. No universal complexity result, completeness result, polynomial-time SAT result or P=NP result follows from the crosswalk.
